description_en: Controls the LED light of an electronic shelf label (ESL) to change its frequency and color
description_zh: 操作价签的Led灯，进行频率和色彩的变换
kebab_example: aliyun cloudesl update-esl-device-light --led-color GREEN --frequency NORMAL --store-id s-dxsxx0000 --item-bar-code 6905605836648 --light-up-time 30 --esl-bar-code 18bc5a631ak9 --extra-params example-string --api-version 2020-02-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEslDeviceLight

parameters.description_en:
The LED color. Valid values:

- `GREEN`: green

- `RED`: red

- `BLUE`: blue

- `OFF`: off.
parameters.description_zh:
亮灯颜色，可选值：

- `GREEN`：绿色

- `RED`：红色

- `BLUE`：蓝色

- `OFF`：关闭。

parameters.description_en:
The LED blinking frequency. Valid values:

- `ALWAYS`: always on

- `HEIGHT`: high frequency

- `MIDDLE`: medium frequency

- `NORMAL`: normal frequency.
parameters.description_zh:
亮灯频率，可选值：

- `HEIGHT`：高频率亮灯

- `MIDDLE`：中频率亮灯

- `NORMAL`：正常频率亮灯。
